paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan, son of Rabbi Chanina.

Mentioned in [Sanhedrin 38b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.38b.2), expounding that the day had twelve hours: in the first hour his dust was gathered, etc. Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Chama, son of Rabbi Chanina, or Rabbi Acha, son of Rabbi Chanina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman records Chama and Acha as alternative readings for Yochanan; none is adopted as a canonical identity.
The linked Sanhedrin names Rabbi Yochanan bar Chanina in the account of the twelve hours of Adam’s first day. Hyman attributes the alternatives Chama and Acha to Dikdukei Soferim.
